avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer reduces saquinavir levels by 50-75%, compromising viral suppression
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; use alternative mood support if needed and monitor CD4/viral load

avoid_supplements.name: Garlic supplements (high-dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction decreases saquinavir bioavailability and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose garlic supplements; fresh garlic in food acceptable

avoid_supplements.name: Rifabutin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer significantly reduces saquinavir plasma concentrations
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; use alternative TB prophylaxis and consult HIV specialist

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 modulation may slightly reduce saquinavir levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor virologic response; dose adjustment unlikely needed

caution_supplements.name: Echinacea
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 induction with inconsistent clinical significance
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; monitor for reduced efficacy

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inhibitor increases saquinavir exposure and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit and pomegranate juice; increased risk of QT prolongation and adverse effects

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: Increases saquinavir absorption; may elevate drug levels and GI side effects
caution_foods.action: Saquinavir should be taken with food; consistent fat intake recommended to maintain stable levels

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-containing beverages
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 substrate competition may slightly increase saquinavir levels
caution_foods.action: Moderate caffeine intake; excessive consumption may potentiate adverse effects

monitoring_notes: Monitor CD4 count, viral load, and liver function regularly as CYP3A4 interactions significantly affect saquinavir efficacy. Assess for QT prolongation risk, especially with high-dose boosting and concurrent QT-prolonging agents; EKG baseline recommended.
